question: A solid cylinder and a cone have the same base radius R and equal volumes. Determine the height of the cone if the height of the cylinder is 12 cm.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of cylinder = Radius of cone = R

Height of cylinder = 12 cm

Volume of cylinder = Volume of cone

**Formula used:**

Volume of cylinder = π × R² × h

Volume of cone = (1/3) × π × R² × h

**Calculation:**

⇒ π × R² × 12 = (1/3) × π × R² × h

⇒ 12 = h ÷ 3

⇒ h = 12 × 3

⇒ h = 36 cm

**∴ The height of the cone is 36 cm.**
